newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Sept unemployment rate falls to 1.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Sept unemployment rate falls to 1.9 pct.

text.p: South Korea's seasonally-adjusted unemployment rate fell to 1.9 percent in September from 2.0 percent a year earlier, provisional figures from the National Statistical Office (NSO) showed on Wednesday.
NOTE: Unemployment rate in brackets calculated before taking seasonal factors into account.
The unemployment rate for the third quarter of this year stood at 1.8 percent, compared with 1.9 percent a year earlier, the office said in a statement.
The economically active population stood at 62.8 percent of the total population in September, unchanged from a year earlier, it added.
